issues_in_review_harness_only: Initial guard injector wrongly required every check to live in a function; the source-only program uses top-level hard guards. Initial attempt stopped before changing any frozen input.

Python3.14 ast.parse inherits the host optimization unless optimize=0 is explicit. The first -OO guard-injection run therefore removed source docstrings, changing only the temporary mutated-copy hash and line numbers. Every original check still rejected, but exact mutated-copy comparison required the explicit mode.
corrections: Force the existing hard guard to reject whether top-level or function-based.
Parse original program with optimize=0 before guard mutation; retain all source AST assertions if any. Rerun all three modes with the same temporary source bytes.
